svg.font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Verdana, sans-serif
svg.title: Butuan and the sea
svg.desc: A modern map of the Philippines and nearby seas. A boat symbol marks Butuan on Mindanao. Dashed lines from Butuan toward China, mainland Southeast Asia and Sumatra are labelled possible connections, not a documented voyage. Separate tags give the boats' dates and the later dates of the imported wares.
